newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Low offer in S.Lanka diesel, jet tender from Shell.
newsitem.headline: Low offer in S.Lanka diesel, jet tender from Shell.

text.p: The lowest offer into Sri Lankan state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp's (CPC) tender to buy diesel and jet fuel for July 27-28 delivery was made by Shell Singapore, a CPC source said on Wednesday.

Shell's offer of 235,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel was 21.9 cents per barrel premium to Singapore spot quotes and 65,000 barrels of jet fuel at 9.4 cents per barrel premium, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Colombo basis.
The tender, which closed on July 2, received six offers. CPC would award the tender late on Thursday, the source said.

In its last tender, Sri Lanka bought from Shell 250,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel at 13.5 cents per barrel premium to Singapore spot quotes and 50,000 barrels of jet fuel at an 18.5-cent premium.
The combination cargo was for July 12-13 delivery, c-and-f Colombo.
